subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should #88204 remain an umbrella for the whole session-routing incident, or should maintainers split it into focused core and plugin-owned follow-ups anchored to #51028 and #93255?
rationale: The issue contains several real but differently owned problems, and automation cannot choose the permanent session-activity model or WeChat core/plugin boundary safely.

options.title: Split and route focused work
options.body: Use #51028 and #93255 as canonical partial tracks, then open or assign separate follow-ups for TUI default sessions and WeChat/background-event isolation with live proof.

options.title: Keep umbrella pending live WeChat proof
options.body: Leave #88204 as the parent tracker until maintainers reproduce the WeChat identity drift and flooding behavior in the current plugin/core stack.

options.title: Close only after focused items land
options.body: Keep this issue open until the current-source gaps are fixed or explicitly declined in their canonical follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Split and route focused work
recommendation.body: Use #51028 and #93255 as canonical partial tracks, then open or assign separate follow-ups for TUI default sessions and WeChat/background-event isolation with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest current-main history signal across the TUI/session surfaces and can route the WeChat portions to the Chinese-channel owner.
